statement.label: ADD-01 use
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: home | work | temp | old | billing - purpose of this address

**Variabiliteit**: code (required)

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-02 type
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: The type of address in question, such as a home address or mailing address.

**Variabiliteit**: code (required)

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-03 text/FullAddress
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: Text representation of the address. Specifies the entire address as it should be displayed e.g. on a postal label.

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: Process: Can provide both a text representation and parts. Applications updating an address SHALL ensure that when both text and parts are present, no content is included in the text that isn't found in a part.

statement.label: ADD-04 line
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: (Human-readable representatie van de onderliggende elementen) This component contains the house number, apartment number, street name, street direction, P.O. Box number, delivery hints, and similar address information.

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: The elements of Address stored in the address-part extensions will be ignored by applications that do not support them, so any information in them should also be duplicated in the Address.line to which they are attached. The value of Address.line should be populated with a complete string representation of all the separate extension values, like: "[Street] [HouseNumberIndication] [HouseNumber] [HouseNumberLetter] [HouseNumberAddition]".

EU-Core: When extensions are used for providing structured information the line element SHOULD be populated with a human readable representation of the line.

statement.label: ADD-05 streetName
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: This component contains the house number, apartment number, street name, street direction, P.O. Box number, delivery hints, and similar address information.

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-06 houseNumber
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: The number of a building, house or lot alongside the street. Also known as "primary street number". This does not number the street but rather the building.

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-07 buildingNumberSuffix
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: Any alphabetic character, fraction or other text that may appear after the numeric portion of a building number.

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-08 additionalLocator
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: This can be a unit designator, such as apartment number, suite number, or floor. There may be several unit designators in an address (e.g., "3rd floor, Appt. 342"). This can also be a designator pointing away from the location, rather than specifying a smaller location within some larger one (e.g., Dutch "t.o." means "opposite to" for house boats located across the street facing houses).

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-09 unitID/AdditionalInformation
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: The number or name of a specific unit contained within a building or complex, as assigned by that building or complex.

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-10 postBox
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: A numbered box located in a post station.

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-11 city/PlaceOfRecidency
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: The name of the city, town, suburb, village or other community or delivery center.

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-12 district/municipality/county
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: The name of the administrative area (county). In the netherlands this refers to Municipality.
Bij Nederlandse gemeenten bij voorkeur de naam uit de GBA tabel 33 (OID: 2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.6.14) gebruiken.

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: 0..1

statement.label: ADD-13 postalCode
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: A postal code designating a region defined by the postal service.  In Dutch addresses, preferably use the postcode from the Postcode table (OID: 2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.4.15).

**Variabiliteit**: string

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-14 country
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: Country - a nation as commonly understood or generally accepted.

**Variabiliteit**: code (required) Codesystem = ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of GBA tabel 34 Landen (2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.4.16.34)

**Aanwezigheid**: -

statement.label: ADD-15 gebruiksperiode
statement.requirement:
**Omschrijving**: Het element useablePeriod duidt de periode aan waarin dit adres 'in gebruik'/geldig is/was.

**Variabiliteit**: Het element useablePeriod duidt de periode aan waarin dit adres 'in gebruik'/geldig is/was. De opties zijn:
Er is geen useablePeriod element: het betreffende adres is in principe onbeperkt geldig.
Er is een onder- en een bovengrens: het adres was geldig in de aangeduide periode.
Er is alleen een ondergrens: het adres is geldig sinds de aangeduide datum.
Er is alleen een bovengrens: het adres was geldig t/m de aangeduide datum.

**Aanwezigheid**: In elke situatie waar één of meer adressen worden doorgegeven, moet minimaal het adres worden aangeduid dat op het moment van verzenden geldig/actueel is. Vervallen adressen kunnen dus alleen worden doorgegeven als het betreffende berichtelement herhalend is (dus met cardinaliteit > 1). Adressen mogen ook in de toekomst geldig worden of vervallen als bijvoorbeeld verhuizing reeds bekend is.
